summary: Bounded array accessor: returns element a2 of a dword array that follows a count field. The count at this+0x4 is the upper bound on a2; out-of-range access returns 0, otherwise it returns this[a2+2] (the dword at this + 8 + 4*a2). Used by two callers, one of which (UtilityFunction_9160) may belong to a different class.

local_names.this: object holding a count at +0x4 followed by a dword array at +0x8
local_names.a2: zero-based element index into the dword array

operations.description: Bounds guard: when a2 >= this[1] (element count at this+0x4) the accessor fails closed and returns 0. Function sub_55BFD0 (ABI lead Bounded_Array_Accessor).
Return this[a2+2], the 32-bit element at this + 8 + 4*a2; the array of dwords begins right after the count field at +0x4.
Return 0 when the requested index a2 is out of range. Called from UtilityFunction_9160 (0x004F9160) and sub_55F0D0 (0x0055F0D0).

unresolved: Element type and semantics of the dword array are unknown; only the count at +0x4 constrains the index.
Whether caller 004F9160 and caller 0055F0D0 share this object layout is not established.
